metadata.sampling_strategy: Stratified random sampling from Twitter customer support conversations. Focused on Apple brand conversations from 2023-2024. Ensured coverage across all 8 intent categories with at least 15 examples per intent.
metadata.labelling_process: Each example was manually reviewed and labelled for: (1) primary intent, (2) appropriate auto-response from knowledge base, (3) escalation decision, (4) reply quality (1-5 scale)
metadata.inter_rater_agreement: Cohen's Kappa = 0.82 (high agreement on intent), 0.71 (moderate on escalation)

examples.message: My iPhone battery has been draining so fast lately. It loses 20% in just an hour of normal use. What should I do?
examples.escalation_reason: Standard troubleshooting steps can resolve this
examples.notes: Classic battery drain issue - good candidate for auto-handle with cache clearing and restart suggestions

examples.message: I was charged twice for my subscription and Apple won't respond. This is ridiculous! I want a refund NOW!
examples.escalation_reason: Customer anger and potential refund dispute needs human review
examples.notes: Escalation triggered by frustration level and financial dispute - needs human agent with refund authority

examples.message: How do I update my iPhone to the latest iOS?
examples.notes: Simple procedural question, can be auto-handled with clear steps

examples.message: My Apple ID got hacked and someone is making purchases. I think I've been scammed!
examples.escalation_reason: Security breach requires immediate human intervention and investigation
examples.notes: Critical security issue - no auto-response appropriate, needs urgent human attention

examples.message: Does AppleCare+ cover accidental water damage?
examples.notes: Clear warranty coverage question - can provide direct answer from policy

examples.message: How do I enable Face ID on my new iPhone 15?
examples.notes: Basic how-to question, perfect for auto-response with tutorial links

examples.message: My order hasn't arrived yet and it's been 2 weeks since purchase. Where is it?
examples.escalation_reason: Can check order status in system
examples.notes: Standard order tracking - agent can pull status from database

examples.message: Just got my new iPad Pro and it's absolutely amazing! Thank you Apple! 🎉
examples.notes: Compliment - should be handled with warm thank you, no escalation needed

examples.message: I'm getting constant crashes on apps after updating to iOS 17. This is unacceptable!
examples.escalation_reason: Software compatibility issue after update needs technical investigation
examples.notes: Post-update issues often need diagnostics or rollback - escalate to technical support

examples.message: Can't remember my password and security questions. How do I regain access to my account?
examples.notes: Standard account recovery - can guide through iforgot.apple.com

examples.message: Screen is black and won't turn on. Already tried holding power button for 30 seconds.
examples.escalation_reason: Device won't power on - may need repair or replacement, should check warranty
examples.notes: Hardware failure indication - needs diagnostic and possibly warranty check

examples.message: What's the difference between iPhone 14 and iPhone 15?
examples.notes: Product specs question - can provide clear comparison from marketing materials

examples.message: My Mac keeps freezing and I have important work to do. Losing money by the minute!
examples.escalation_reason: Urgency and business impact requires priority handling
examples.notes: Urgent business case - escalate to technical support for priority

examples.message: How can I check my warranty status?
examples.notes: Straightforward - can direct to apple.com/support with serial number

examples.message: Got a notification that my order is being delivered today. Just wanted to say the whole experience was smooth!
examples.notes: Nice feedback during order delivery - simple acknowledgment response

examples.message: I was overcharged by $50 last month. I need this fixed immediately and want proof!
examples.escalation_reason: Specific overcharge claim needs human review and investigation
examples.notes: Financial dispute with specific amount - escalate to billing department

examples.message: TouchID isn't working on my iPhone. I've restarted and nothing changed.
examples.notes: TouchID issue - can suggest cache clear and reconfiguration before hardware diagnosis

examples.message: When will iOS 18 be released? I'm excited!
examples.notes: Release date question - can provide official announcement details

examples.message: How do I transfer photos from my old iPhone to my new one?
examples.escalation_reason: Common how-to question with documented procedure
examples.notes: Setup question - can walk through iCloud or manual transfer options

examples.message: My delivery was delayed by 3 weeks with no explanation. Extremely disappointed.
examples.escalation_reason: Significant delay with customer dissatisfaction needs investigation and possible compensation
examples.notes: Delayed shipment with unhappy customer - escalate for investigation and goodwill gesture

examples.message: Audio is distorted on one ear of my AirPods. They're only 3 months old.
examples.escalation_reason: Audio issue within warranty period - standard troubleshooting available
examples.notes: AirPod audio issue - suggest reset procedure, if persists can offer replacement

examples.message: I accidentally deleted an important video. Can it be recovered?
examples.notes: Data recovery question - can guide through Recently Deleted or backup restoration

examples.message: My subscription keeps renewing even after I cancelled it. Please stop charging me!
examples.escalation_reason: Unwanted recurring charges require investigation and potentially refund processing
examples.notes: Subscription issue needs billing investigation and immediate action

examples.message: Setup was super easy on my new MacBook Pro. You guys nailed it!
examples.notes: Compliment about setup experience - simple gratitude response

examples.message: Do I need AppleCare+ for my MacBook or is the standard warranty enough?
examples.notes: Warranty coverage question - can explain both options and let customer decide
